recipes.note: Face-only recipes for the PlayerBase candidates. Coefficient-space blend of MH_PlayerBase's conformed face with Epic's built-in presets (/MetaHumanCharacter/Optional/Presets). out = ours + sum w_i*(preset_i - ours) per face-model region; 'blend' applies to every region not listed in 'regions'. Region groups: Scripts/MetaHuman/pb_face_build.py REGION_GROUPS. Body state untouched.

MH_PlayerBase_FaceA.concept: rounder, fuller-cheeked young face; open eyes; short broad nose (Bo-led)

MH_PlayerBase_FaceB.concept: angular, broad-cheekboned, square-chinned face (Aoi-led, Victor jaw/nose)

MH_PlayerBase_FaceC.concept: strong broad lower face, wide nose, full mouth (Kelvin eyes, Jorge nose/mouth/jaw)
